newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on new arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on new arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices on Tuesday fell to 1,133/1,134 rupees from 1,141/1,142 rupees on reports of rising new crop arrivals, dealers said.

Castorseed arrivals from Gujarat rose to 13-15,000 bags (75 kg each). Groundnut oil fell further from 341/342 rupees to 338/340 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish physical enquiries and fresh new crop arrivals of about 100/120 tonnes.
"Arrivals of 2,500 tonnes of imported palm oil at the Bombay port also aided the subdued sentiments for groundnut oil," one broker said.
In Rajkot, spot oil was steady at 515 rupees per 15 kg.
